item.title: Automation Is Not the Same as Efficiency
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Automation Is Not the Same as Efficiency There is a confusion that repeats itself almost systematically — in vendor proposals, and in the board meetings where AI and operating cost reduction are discussed. Automation, and removing the human factor, gets presented as a synonym for efficiency. It isn’t. And the difference lands directly on the customer experience and, from there, on the P&L. Efficiency is making a process generate more profitability, more business capacity and a better experience for the customer.
